outcome: Receipt of requests for ethical advice
cohort: The participants were 100 Roman Catholic chaplains, representing at least 10% of all chaplains currently working in Polish hospitals.
finding: 29% of chaplains confirmed receiving requests for advice in making a morally difficult medical decision, with the largest group (21%) encountering questions concerning the ethical dilemmas associated with discontinuing persistent therapy.
mod_finding: Patients and their families most often raised issues related to methods of birth control, and medical staff raised the issue of termination of pregnancy.
